content: A GitLab LTD (UK) team member can take up to 4 weeks of unpaid parental leave per child each year, unless otherwise agreed with their employer [1].

messages.content:
You answer questions about the GitLab company handbook using ONLY the numbered passages provided.
- Base every statement on the passages and cite them like [1] or [2][3].
- If the passages do not contain the answer, reply exactly: "I don't know based on the handbook." Do not guess or use outside knowledge.
- If the answer depends on a country, entity or situation, say which one the passage covers.
- Be concise: at most 3 sentences.

Passages:
[1] [GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family leaves > Unpaid Parental Leave]
Effective 6 April 2026, eligibility for Unpaid Parental Leave starts from a team member's first day of employment. The previous requirement of one year of continuous service is abolished.

Leave Entitlement

- Team members are eligible for Unpaid Parental Leave from their first day of employment.
- Up to 18 weeks of unpaid leave per child, to look after their child's welfare.
- The entitlement is per child up to the age of 18, regardless of the person's employer.
- The balance of unpaid parental leave carries over to each employer. For example, if someone has taken 10 weeks of unpaid parental leave with their previous employer, they would be entitled to 8 weeks of leave with their new employer.
- Each parent can take up to 4 weeks each year per child, unless otherwise agreed with their employer.
- Leave must be taken in blocks of weeks rather than individual days.
- Team members must provide at least 21 days' notice.

How to Apply

Contact leaves@gitlab.com.

[2] [GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family leaves > Adoption Leave]
Leave Entitlement

- Up to 52 weeks leave available
- Team members can receive statutory adoption pay for up to 39 weeks
- Team members must have had continuous employment with GitLab for at least 26 weeks leading up to the week they were matched with the child.
- Eligible team members are entitled to 90% of your average weekly earnings (before tax) for the first 6 weeks, £194.32 or 90% of your average weekly earnings (whichever is lower) for the next 33 weeks

How to Apply

- Submit leave request in Workday (Parental Leave Category) 30+ days before start
- Provide proof of the adoption or surrogacy to leaves@gitlab.com
- The Absence Management team will notify payroll and email Vistra a copy of the form, dates of leave and outline what pay the team member is eligible for (statutory, supplemental, etc)

[3] [GitLab Ireland Ltd > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family Leaves > Parental Leave]
Flexibility for ongoing childcare needs.  

Leave Entitlement

- Up to 26 weeks unpaid leave  
- For children under 12 (16 with disability)  
- Can split into blocks with manager approval  
- Requires 1 year employment

  

How to Apply

1. Notify leaves@gitlab.com 6 weeks in advance
2. Sign confirmation document 4 weeks before leave

[4] [GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family leaves > Maternity Leave]
Leave Entitlement

- Team members must have continuous employment with GitLab for at least 26 weeks leading up to the "qualifying week" (15th week before the expected week of childbirth)
- Up to 52 weeks leave available
- First 39 weeks paid (combining statutory and GitLab benefits)
- 90% of average earnings for first 6 weeks (before tax), then statutory rate (£194.32/week) or 90% (whichever is lower) of the team member's average weekly earnings (whichever is lower) for the next 33 weeks. This also applies to the leave amounts provided for Parental Leave and Adoption Leave.
- GitLab's enhanced policy provides up to 16 weeks at 100% salary

How to Apply

[5] [GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family leaves > Paternity Leave]
Leave Entitlement

- Effective 6 April 2026, eligibility for Statutory Paternity Leave starts from a team member's first day of employment. The previous requirement of 26 weeks of continuous service is abolished.
- Team members can receive Statutory Paternity Pay for up to 2 weeks or up to 37 weeks if taking Shared Parental Leave
- Eligible team members are entitled to £194.32 or 90% of the team member's average weekly earnings (whichever is lower) for up to 2 weeks OR up to 37 weeks if taking Shared Parental Leave
- GitLab's enhanced policy provides up to 16 weeks at 100% salary
- Leave must be taken within 52 weeks of the child's birth

How to Apply

- Submit leave request in Workday (Parental Leave Category) 30+ days before start
- Send completed [SPP Form](https://www.tax.service.gov.uk/print-and-post/form/PersonalTax_iForms/1.0/SC3/sc3.xdp) or one of the [SPL Forms](https://www.acas.org.uk/shared-parental-leave-form-templates) to leaves@gitlab.com
- The Absence Management team will notify payroll and email Vistra a copy of the form, dates of leave and outline what pay the team member is eligible for (statutory, supplemental, etc).

[6] [GitLab Ireland Ltd > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family Leaves > Parent's Leave]
Extended support for new parents.  

Leave Entitlement

- 9 weeks leave in child's first 2 years  
- Can be taken consecutively or separately  
- State Parent's Benefit available (subject to PRSI)  
- GitLab salary top-up applies if taken within the first 16 weeks of GitLab's Parental Leave

  

How to Apply

1. Notify leaves@gitlab.com 6 weeks in advance
2. Apply for benefit via [gov.ie](https://www.gov.ie/en/service/b321b1-parents-benefit/) 4 weeks before leave

Question: How many weeks of unpaid parental leave can a GitLab LTD (UK) team member take per child each year?
